From [[Brandon Sanderson]]'s [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/blog/832/MileHiCon-Signing-Deadline-Allomantic-Table-Updates website]:

I haven't really mentioned it on the blog here, but I am going to be the toastmaster at [http://www.milehicon.org/ MileHiCon] in Denver next weekend, October 23rd through 25th. I'll post a specific schedule next week of where you'll find me at the con. I'll also be doing a signing on the 22nd at the Koelbel Library in Centennial that's open to all (convention registration not required). This is all before the release of THE GATHERING STORM, though, so Denver residents should also keep in mind that I'll be back in town on November 1st during the book tour. For details please see my [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/events Events page].

I'm going to be signing and personalizing Sam Weller's Bookstore's copies of THE GATHERING STORM on October 19th starting at 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, so if you want to order a copy from them, that is the last moment you can request a personalization. They'll still accept orders after that for the remainder of the signed stock, but you'll be limited to a signature and a number unless you call them before 5:00 on the 19th. For details please see Item #4 on the [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/article/57/THE-GATHERING-STORM-Release-Events#item4 Release Events page].

The limited-edition [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/store/item/39/ Mistborn Table of Allomantic Metals] art prints have been delivered here to Dragonsteel Entertainment headquarters, and artist [http://nethermore.rocketroadtrip.com/ Isaac Stewart] and I will be signing them tonight. We'll start taking orders probably tomorrow; expect a big announcement here on the blog.

In this week's [http://www.writingexcuses.com/2009/10/11/ Writing Excuses podcast], Dan, Howard, and I talk with Larry Correia, author of [http://www.amazon.com/dp/1439132852/?tag=monkeyslothst-20 Monster Hunter International], about plot-driven vs. character-driven fiction. [http://www.writingexcuses.com/2009/10/11/ Go check it out!]

The most recent MISTBORN 3 annotations involve the trilogy's first ball scene in quite a while. Chapter 30 was a lot of fun for me to write; I hope it gave many readers fond memories of MISTBORN 1. [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/annotation/293/Mistborn-3-Chapter-Thirty Part 1], [http://www.brandonsanderson.com/annotation/294/Mistborn-3-Chapter-Thirty-Part-2 Part 2].
